{{Quote|Are you in trouble again, Skywalker?''"<br />"''Of course I am. Have you ever known me when I wasn't?|Mara Jade and Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Specter" />}}
The '''Mission to the Kauron asteroid field''' was a mission carried on by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] at the beginning of the [[Caamas Document Crisis]], during his search for the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] used by the [[Cavrilhu Pirates]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Pinchers usually makes this run. How come he's not here?''"<br />"''He came down with something and can't fly.|Luke Skywalker and a pirate sentry|<ref name="Specter" />}}
During a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Raid at Iphigin|raid]] at [[Iphigin]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] discovered that the [[Cavrilhu Pirates]] used [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] in their [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. On the planet [[Wistril]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] captured the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Pinchers]] and planned to pretend to be his substitute in order to infiltrate their [[Cavrilhu's Kauron base|base]] with his [[Y60 Thalassian cargo hauler|Y60 freighter]].

==The mission==
{{Quote|We set this up about five years ago. Your Yavin academy was seeding the galaxy with cocky little would-be Jedi, and we figured it would be only a matter of time before one of them dropped in on us. So we figured to have a surprise ready for them. Never figured on having the Grand High Moffling himself show up. So, what do you think?''"<br />"''It's inventive, I'll give you that. I hope you're not expecting it to hold me for long.|Control and Luke Skywalker, about the zero gravity chamber|<ref name="Specter" />}}
Luke Skywalker tracked the pirates back to their base in the [[Kauron asteroid field]]. Luke successfully infiltrated their base, but was quickly discovered. He resisted the pirates's [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] but was trapped in a zero [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] chamber. While the pirates evacuated the base, [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] in the ''[[Starry Ice]]'' arrived in the [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]]. Skywalker escaped the trap and eventually fled the base by plunging in the [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]] of space in a [[Force healing/Legends|healing trance]]. He was rescued by [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] shortly before the base self-destructed. [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] also managed to escape, in the [[T-65B X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] hidden in Luke's [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]]. They finally had to fight the orbital defenses disguised as [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] to go out the asteroid field.

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|You and Skywalker make a pretty good team.|Shirlee Faughn to Mara Jade|<ref name="Specter" />}}
Luke and Mara's reunion was interrupted by the intrusion of a [[Nssis-class Clawcraft|mysterious fighter]] in the system. Further investigations about it eventually led to the discovery of the [[Empire of the Hand]].
